signature.instructions:
Predict where a stock's post-earnings unexpected return will land.

Deliberately terse. The point of the exercise is that the optimiser writes the
instructions; seeding it with our own hand-written prompt would be measuring
our prompt again.

fields.description: Facts extracted from the company's earnings call.
Percentile in [0,1] of this stock's next-day unexpected return relative to all other earnings announcements this quarter. 0 = most negative, 0.5 = typical, 1 = most positive.
